verdict.rationale: Summer Engine is a game-engine platform, not an agent itself, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. Its first-party docs describe the server directly: one command configures supported agents, the server ships docs search/read tools, and agents can run the publishing flow and read analytics through the MCP. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works, a fully documented tool catalog beyond the docs-search tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: One command configures any of these agents:
The MCP server ships summer\_docs\_search and summer\_docs\_read, so the model can pull Summer guidance in-chat.
Your agent runs the whole publishing flow on Summer Games through the MCP or CLI.
Any agent can read your game's analytics through the MCP
